record_type: catalogue change events; not conjunction warnings or manoeuvre records

payload.note: New catalogued objects, recorded reentries and significant orbit changes. Published within a day of the catalog updating, never in real time. Poll with ?since=<ISO 8601 timestamp>, exclusive, and ?limit=1-500; meta.latest_detected_at is the cursor to send back. History is not paginated: only the newest entries in the change log are reachable, so a consumer that stops polling cannot recover the gap.
